hard_gates.name: credential-and-session-boundary
hard_gates.evidence: The control uses synthetic account headers rather than credentials and revocable cookies.

hard_gates.name: durable-owned-state
hard_gates.evidence: The control onboarding repository is process memory.

hard_gates.name: recoverable-asynchronous-ingestion
hard_gates.evidence: The control parses synchronously and has no leased recovery queue.

hard_gates.name: migration-and-clean-restore
hard_gates.evidence: The control has no complete migration and clean backup/restore workflow.

hard_gates.name: security-and-observability
hard_gates.evidence: The control has no credential boundary, staging rate limits, or administrator metrics.

hard_gates.name: bounded-capacity
hard_gates.evidence: No frozen 100-request capacity measurement exists for the control architecture.

hard_gates.name: rollback-availability
hard_gates.evidence: The local synthetic professor/student demo remains runnable.

hard_gates.name: credential-and-session-boundary
hard_gates.evidence: Invite login, secure cookie, expiry/revocation, password rotation/reset, and synthetic-header rejection pass.

hard_gates.name: durable-owned-state
hard_gates.evidence: Account, onboarding, course, source, release, conversation, citation, and audit state survive repository restart.

hard_gates.name: recoverable-asynchronous-ingestion
hard_gates.evidence: Idempotent enqueue, leased claim, completion, cancellation, retry, and expired-lease recovery pass.

hard_gates.name: migration-and-clean-restore
hard_gates.evidence: Schema v5 clean/legacy/rollback checks and checksum-verified clean restore pass.

hard_gates.name: security-and-observability
hard_gates.evidence: Authorization, origin, rate, upload, log-redaction, metrics/alerts, lifecycle, and provider-budget checks pass.

hard_gates.name: bounded-capacity
hard_gates.evidence: 100 requests had 0% errors, 2.964 ms p95, and 0.30 GiB peak RSS on the development host.

hard_gates.name: rollback-availability
hard_gates.evidence: The A0 demo was started against synthetic data after the candidate recovery checks.

decision.rationale: A1 passed all 41 local acceptance and capacity checks while preserving A0. Public DNS, certificate issuance, and host-side restore remain the only architecture-selection evidence not exercised.
limitations: The result uses synthetic accounts, one authored PDF, and one development host.
Public HTTPS certificate issuance and a clean host deployment were not exercised.
The container graph validates, but base-image registry resolution stalled in the current environment.
The capacity measurement excludes external generation and public network latency.
The result does not establish real-course quality, human usability, multi-host scale, or a production SLA.
